content.rendered: Our apologies to any families who showed up this past Saturday (July 6) for the Kindergarten Play Date.  That event was incorrectly calendared and should have been set for July 9.  However, due to ongoing construction at Archer Glen, the July 9 play date is also canceled.  Please plan to attend the August play date on August 6, at 6:30 pm.
